Hi Jordan / Claire,

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation and happy to see the team interested in moving forward. Quick recap and a short list of items we need to qualify procurement and billing so we can prepare a clean commercial path:

- Card: possible for initial pilot, but larger commitments typically use PO / invoice.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace - if you prefer to transact via Marketplace we can provide Marketplace listing details (note: invoicing flows differ).

- Vendor legal name to appear on invoice
- Remit-to / billing address (for tax and payment processing)
- Tax / VAT or tax ID (if applicable)
- Preferred invoice format (PDF is typical; if you need a different format let us know)
- Standard net terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.) or if you require purchase-order-processing SLA details
- Accounts payable contact and email to receive invoices

3) Attachments / examples attached
- Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW for pilot)
- pricing-estimate.pdf (high-level pricing discussed on call)
- Procurement-checklist.pdf (vendor onboarding fields we usually need)

Next steps
- Can you confirm PO vs card vs marketplace?
- Please send the billing contact, remit-to address, and any required vendor paperwork (W-9 or equivalent). If you want, fill the attached ACME_PO_template and send back.

If helpful I can introduce our billing ops lead to run through vendor setup - happy to loop them in once you confirm the preferred path.

Thanks,
